name: OpenBot
description: Runs open-source AI coworkers that each get a sandboxed computer with their own browser logins, files, and granted tools. Every action is pre-approved and recorded.

skills.name: Agent Computer
skills.description: Provisions each AI coworker an isolated computer with a persistent browser profile, filesystem, and scoped tool access.

skills.name: Action Approval
skills.description: Gates every agent action behind human pre-approval and writes an immutable record of what the agent did.

skills.name: AG-UI Bridge
skills.description: Connects framework-agnostic agent backends over AG-UI, including LangGraph, Mastra, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, and Google ADK.
